scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @eligibility/web" "npm run dev -w @eligibility/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eligibility/shared && npm run build -w @eligibility/eligibility && npm run build -w @eligibility/api && npm run build -w @eligibility/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @eligibility/shared && npm run typecheck -w @eligibility/eligibility && npm run typecheck -w @eligibility/api && npm run typecheck -w @eligibility/web
